headline: Long-distance friendship is just REPLICATION with high latency. You think you're in sync until you realize you're two life updates behind.
caption:
Long-distance friendship is just REPLICATION with high latency. You think you're in sync until you realize you're two life updates behind.

REPLICATION: keeping copies of the same data in step across several machines.
